name: So you think you know Brisbane?

mentions.name: So you think you know Brisbane?
mentions.description: A browser game in which players guess the suburbs of Brisbane, Australia. It is being expanded to cover all large cities in Queensland, moved to its own domain, and monetized to cover hosting costs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a game called "So you think you know Brisbane?", in which you guess the suburbs of Brisbane, Australia.
